in_sanskrit.name: हरिद्धि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The goddess of wealth, prosperity, and abundance. She is also known as the goddess of wisdom and knowledge. She is often depicted holding a pot of gold or a lotus in her hands.

in_hindi.name: ह्रिद्धि
in_hindi.long_meaning: समृद्धि (samriddhi) means wealth, prosperity, and abundance. Hriddhi is the goddess of this quality, who is often worshipped for her blessings of financial success and material comfort.

in_tamil.name: ஹிர்த்தி
in_tamil.long_meaning: அருவத்து (aruvattu) means wealth, prosperity, and abundance. Hriddhi is the goddess of this quality, who is often worshipped for her blessings of financial success and material comfort.

in_telugu.name: హృధ్ధి
in_telugu.long_meaning: శోద్శి (shodashi) means wealth, prosperity, and abundance. Hriddhi is the goddess of this quality, who is often worshipped for her blessings of financial success and material comfort.

in_marathi.name: Hriddhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hriddhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of wealth and prosperity, a form of Lakshmi. Derived from the Sanskrit root 'hrid', meaning 'heart'.

in_bengali.name: Hriddhi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Wealth, Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Hriddhi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess of wealth and prosperity, a form of Lakshmi. Derived from the Sanskrit root 'hrid', meaning 'heart'.
